title: Great tour for the money
text: Thanks to Mart, our driver and tour guide for this tour. He explained the history of the tour and very patient in taking care of us. A very well organized tour and enough time to satisfy our expectations. Thank you Matt. Till next time.
author: W5510LCjeromec

title: Monserrat at its best
text: Pablo was fantastic, he was the best tour guide we have had by far and this was our 6th tour in 12 days. He is very smart and very funny and the tour of Montserrat was a spiritual experience unequalled ever. We are so grateful we did Montserrat and Sagrada was awesome as well . Definitely recommend highly this tour with Pablo
author: OnAir569194

title: Best.  Excursion.  Ever.
text:
Best.  Excursion . Ever.  Our guide Aleix, loves his work.  He loves people.  The excursion was perfect for us.  

Good communication via text the day before and the day of the excursion.  Clean car in good condition.  Explanation of the itinerary along with ability to provide input.  

Aleix hit all the locations in the description plus several others that gave a real feel for Barcelona from different perspectives.  We feel that we could not have asked for a better day!

title: Great Day!!!
text: Our guide, Ramon, was a fountain of knowledge!!!! A wonderful day! Good driver, passionate about Barcelona and its culture!! Ask for him!!!

title: Amazing day

title: Barcelona trip

title: Our day in Barcelona either Liana
